card.summary: Cars245 is an online car parts store with an EU warehouse in Riga and worldwide shipping through DHL, UPS, FedEx, USPS and EMS. The catalog holds more than 4 million parts searchable by OEM part number.
card.best_for: Best for buyers outside the US who know the OEM number.
card.strength: Per its FAQ, in-stock items marked Ready to ship take "approximately 24 hours" to be handled and shipped. Payment works by PayPal, Visa, Mastercard or Maestro, and support replies within 1 working day.
card.limitation: Buyers outside the EU may pay import duties, and delivery time varies. Returns need approval within 14 days, parts must be new and unused, and the buyer pays return shipping. Trustpilot shows 4.3 of 5 across 116 reviews.

card.summary: RockAuto is an online parts catalog that, per its help page, ships everywhere in the world unless prohibited by law. Shipping quotes appear after you enter a country and postal code.
card.best_for: Best for buyers who already know the part they need and want a worldwide option.
card.strength: Orders generally ship within one business day, and the store collects named taxes such as GST, HST or VAT, plus duties and brokerage fees, when the order is placed. Payment works by cards, PayPal, Sezzle or wire transfer.
card.limitation: Returns are accepted within 30 days for the part price, shipping charges are not refundable unless the return is its mistake, and duties cannot be refunded. Trustpilot shows 1.8 of 5 across 3,506 reviews.

card.summary: CarParts.com is an online store that states it ships only within the continental United States. Buyers outside that area cannot order directly and would need a package forwarder or another store.
card.best_for: Best for US buyers who want many payment options.
card.strength: The store's FAQ lists payment by Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Zip. Its return policy, as quoted in a Better Business Bureau response, requires returns within 30 days of delivery.
card.limitation: No international delivery is offered, and the FAQ gives no shipping times. Core returns have a 60 day window and need an RMA number, with return shipping paid by the buyer. Trustpilot shows 3.8 of 5 across 27,008 reviews.

card.summary: PartsGeek is an online store that states more than 10 million auto parts and a selection of OEM, stock replacement or aftermarket parts. Its homepage describes shipping from locations throughout the United States.
card.best_for: Best for US buyers who want a wide catalog and a clear 30 day return window.
card.strength: Returns are accepted within 30 days of purchase with a return authorization number, and many product listings show free ground shipping.
card.limitation: Items must be new, unused and in original packaging, electrical parts are not returnable, and the customer pays return shipping unless stated otherwise. Check shipping and payment at checkout before ordering, and compare the total. Trustpilot shows 3.6 of 5 across 176,215 reviews.

card.summary: Autodoc is a European online store whose UK site lists Great Britain, the Isle of Man, Jersey, Guernsey and a long list of European countries on its delivery page. It does not list the US, Canada, Australia or Israel.
card.best_for: Best for buyers in Great Britain and Europe who want published delivery thresholds.
card.strength: In-stock items are sent within 1 to 2 working days after payment. Delivery in Great Britain costs £8.45 below £140 and is free from £140. Payment works by PayPal, bank card or bank transfer.
card.limitation: Returns allow 14 days from delivery, and the paid Safe Order option extends that to 200 days. Marketplace orders are delivered within the UK only. Trustpilot shows 4.1 of 5 across 20,052 reviews.

card.limitation: Taxes and duties are not prepaid and are set by the carrier on delivery. The customer pays return shipping unless the store states otherwise. Trustpilot shows 4.6 of 5 across 2,097 reviews.

alternatives_extra.name: Amazon
alternatives_extra.text: Offers a Confirmed Fit tool that checks a part against your vehicle's year, make, model, drivetrain and engine type. Listings come from many sellers, so shipping, returns and import duties differ from listing to listing. Read the seller's terms and return policy before you buy.

alternatives_extra.name: eBay Motors
alternatives_extra.text: Offers a My Garage feature for checking that a part fits your vehicle. Listings come from many sellers, so shipping, returns and import duties differ from listing to listing. Read the seller's terms and return policy before you buy.

alternatives_extra.name: PartsAvatar
alternatives_extra.text: A Canadian store that states free shipping on orders over CAD $99 and shipping across Canada. That is a store claim from its services page, so confirm the shipping cost, the delivery time and the return terms at checkout before you pay for the order.
